items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Because I worked with Pierron, you know, I worked with Pierron about two years.

ctx.x: Yeah knowing what chord you were playing.

Knowing what you were doing. I don't mean to say a lot of variation because so many trumpet players before and older and probably before I was born did a lot, whereas I've heard on later in later years. But I mean actually following that chord pattern, I just, I could just start, and the average guy around New Orleans knows me around my, say around my age or maybe a little older. They know, they tell you that. Like Eddie Pearson and all these guys, you know Eddie Pearson. Because I worked with Pierron, you know,…
Where did you work with him?
